key_highlights: RBA delivers an aggressive rate hike pushing the cash rate to an 18-year high, prompting immediate major bank pass-through and recession warnings.
Department store giant David Jones stands on the brink of administration over unpaid Westfield rents, threatening retail REIT cash flows.
High Court delivers an $81m payroll tax ruling against Uber, establishing a costly legal precedent for Australia's gig economy.
Global crude oil prices crash, weighing heavily on ASX energy producers despite temporary broader market resilience on RBA day.
Dwelling prices drop for a seventh consecutive month as mortgage stress intensifies and investor demand retreats.

sectors.trend: Major banks pass through RBA rate hikes to an 18-year peak while sounding explicit alarms on recession and debt servicing stress.
sectors.implications: Heightened credit impairment risks and slowing credit expansion threaten medium-term return on equity across major lenders.

sectors.trend: Commercial retail landlords face anchor tenant defaults and residential markets suffer a seven-month price decline alongside rising vacancies.
sectors.implications: Landlords with large departmental exposures face rental arrears, void periods, and downward asset revaluations.

sectors.trend: Disposable household incomes contract severely under peak mortgage rates, precipitating critical distress at major retail chains.
sectors.implications: David Jones's insolvency risk heralds widespread earnings downgrades and store footprint rationalisation across the discretionary space.

sectors.trend: Crude benchmarks plunge amidst softening global demand expectations, driving steep losses across ASX-listed oil and gas producers.
sectors.implications: Free cash flow yields will compress, curbing near-term capital returns and triggering negative earnings revisions.

sectors.trend: Regulatory and tax pressures mount post-High Court Uber ruling, compounded by large-scale tech workforce retrenchment.
sectors.implications: Platform businesses face significant payroll tax exposure and margin compression; valuation multiples remain vulnerable to high bond yields.

sectors.trend: Bulk commodity headwinds in the Pilbara contrast with targeted drill hits in titanium and polymetallic exploration.
sectors.implications: Subdued Chinese industrial demand curbs upside for large-cap iron ore miners, shifting focus to cost control and balance sheet resilience.

key_themes: Monetary tightening to 18-year highs driving acute household balance sheet contraction and rising recession probabilities
Structural stress in commercial retail property anchored by the imminent collapse of David Jones
Labour reclassification and payroll tax liabilities threatening Australian platform tech business models
Sharp divergence across commodities with crude oil plunging while domestic miners face soft bulk demand

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical financials and consumer discretionary; allocate to quality defensive cash generators.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Real Estate Vacancy & Valuation Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to discretionary retail REITs; overweight industrial logistics and prime infrastructure assets.
Audit platform holdings for contractor-dependent labour liabilities and state payroll tax exposure.
Hedge upstream crude price exposure and position in low-cost producers with strong balance sheets.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight defensive consumer staples and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Inelastic end-market demand insulates operating earnings from severe consumer belt-tightening and elevated rate pressure.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to critical minerals and high-grade exploration
opportunities.rationale: Strategic resources in titanium and polymetallics offer secular growth upside decoupled from domestic credit cycles.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Divest or underweight discretionary retail REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Imminent David Jones administration creates lease default, extended vacancy, and dividend risk for retail landlords.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad market downside and trim consumer cyclical exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated mortgage rates and bank recession warnings elevate downside vulnerability across high-beta ASX equities.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound with heightened downside volatility as an 18-year peak cash rate and corporate insolvencies erode market breadth.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued recovery path capped by household deleveraging and corporate margin compression prior to anticipated policy easing in late 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA post-meeting monetary statement and revised GDP/inflation trajectories
Formal appointment of administrators and lease renegotiations for David Jones
State revenue office responses to High Court Uber contractor ruling
Australian quarterly wage growth and retail sales volume prints
watch_list: Major bank 90+ day mortgage delinquency rates (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX)
Scentre Group (SCG.AX) operational updates and rental collection metrics
Crude oil benchmark stabilization levels (WTI and Brent)
AUD/USD reaction to rising domestic recession probabilities
